opis: The view from HIGH UP in a treehouse: in the foreground the big round wooden window of the treehouse from the reference picture, and leaning out of it, seen from behind and a little from the side, the BEAR with his paws on the sill, the FOX and the little SQUIRREL beside him, all three looking out and down in wonder. Below and far away the WHOLE FOREST seen from above: soft green tree tops rolling to the hills, a winding brook glittering, a small orchard with apple trees in a clearing right below, a meadow, birds flying BELOW the window. Bright summer morning, a wide open sky. The feeling: we are so high up, we can see everything.
